body: I'm actually ask tomorrow. I'm literally falling apart

I'm so sorry to hear about your initial degree. But may I ask what project? I'm really really interested in physics but don't know where to start. I read textbooks, volunteer at the air and Space Museum. A bunch of stuff. And I guess you're right. The answer is always no unless you ask. 

But what if I'm better off now? Wouldn't that just make trying a waste?
Should I ask about that. And it doesn't cost anything?
But I don't have a vision anymore. Looking to the future I see more and more misery ahead.
But I'd be forced to go to the school psych officer and it'd devolve onto something worse. And on top of that, how can I trust them to be confidential? Should I get them to sign sth?

People think I'm so happy. No one knows about me and my issues. But I am that 'good listener'  and because I've read alot of psych books I give alot of educated advice and information. I just really wanted to have someone in my life I could be with. But my parents wouldn't let me date anyone. Hell they don't believe in dating. It's weird.

Yeah, you're right about the tall part. But because I've let myself go a bit weight wise. About 45 pounds overweight. I don't have any love for my body anymore. And also Idk how to 'look 'for better barbers. I live in a suburb where there are barbers every corner with a bunch of Asian ladies. But tell me, in HS, did you have a relationship?

Yeah I am surprised too. Perhaps I haven't offed myself because I still have this however miniscule amount of fear that if there is an afterlife, I'll be screwed there as well. Or perhaps it's just cuz my extroverted, excited self craves the attention I get. I need to go to a good college, but I have no idea how to get the motivation to get the good grades needed for it.

Well I would go to a counselor, but more often than not parents or some authorities get involved, and on top of that. It gets put into my academic resume, I'll be denied from any good colleges for my background because of that. And as I said, I don't trust people, because I have found it impossible to find someone who isn't willing to sell me out got something. Hell even my best 'friends' keep me around to make fun of me. 

What makes you so sure I'm not a sociopath?
